Syllabus & Course Modules

Module 1

Visual Arts & Design Foundations

Understand color harmony wheels, visual hierarchies, negative spacing rules, contrast ratios, and structural layout grids.

Module 2

Adobe Photoshop Masterclass

Deep-dive into tools, workspace setup, layer hierarchies, non-destructive editing workflows, custom masks, and typography styling.

Module 3

Vector Graphics with Adobe Illustrator

Master the pen tool, anchor points adjustments, pathfinders, typography outlining, custom logo grids, and SVG exports.

Module 4

Fast-track Designing via Canva Pro

Structure high-speed brand templates, manage asset libraries, design visual assets, and establish collaborative workspaces.

Module 5

Brand Identity Systems Construction

Build complete corporate brand identities: design logos, style guides, brand palettes, packaging concepts, and letterheads.

Module 6

Print-ready Design Files & Typography

Understand bleed lines, margins boundaries, CMYK vs. RGB channels, exporting printer formats, and layout sizing ratios.

Module 7

Digital Ad Design & Marketing Creatives

Design conversion-focused ads: banner creatives, social carousel templates, promotional banners, and custom graphics.

Module 8

Client Acquisition & Design Freelancing

Construct a professional design portfolio. Structure Fiverr and Upwork profiles, write creative pitches, and close clients.

Module 9

Capstone Branding Project

Assemble, organize, and present a complete corporate brand identity mockup project from initial design brief to final exports.
